_comment_week1_start: Sunday that week 1 begins. Deadline for week N = the Saturday of that week, 11:59pm ET.
_comment_current_week: null = work it out from the date (weeks run Sunday to Saturday). Put a number here to pin it.
_comment_stats_only: true = replays and sheet writes only: no Sunday overdue sweep, and teams can /report without a /schedule'd time.
_comment_write_grid_scores: false = leave the Non-Conference score cells alone (Bot Results, Game Scores and Game Stats are still written).
_comment_message_content_intent: true lets /backfill read old results posts. Turn on Message Content Intent in the Developer Portal FIRST or the bot won't connect.
